Commentary.Commentary: The players are out in the middle again. We have around 7 overs left in the day. 45 minutes left. Can Bangladesh get a wicket or two just to boost their confidence?
... 3RD INNINGS ...

Well, 8 out of the 10 wickets have gone to spinners in the innings. Are we surprised? Not even a bit. When you play in Sri Lanka, you do expect a trial by spin and Bangladesh have faltered largely. Debutant Jayawickrama did not let the absence of Lasith Embuldeniya to be felt and ran through the opposition. Surprisingly, in spite of the poor weather forecast, SRI LANKA HAVE NOT ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON...

A bizarre batting display by Bangladesh. It began with some promise, as Tamim Iqbal and Saif Hassan set out confidently, chasing 494. The duo added 98 for the opening wicket but 15 minutes before Lunch, Saif fell and on the last ball before the break, Shanto departed. Post Lunch, there was a bit of a partnership between Tamim, Mominul and Rahim but Rahim's wicket triggered a collapse. Bangladesh were 214/3, but then lost their last 7 wickets for just 37 runs. The innings fell into tatters as the batsmen simply struggled against the turning ball.

First question - Is the follow-on enforced? Answer - A possible no. Because Sri Lanka are lazily walking back to the pavilion, which indicates no urgency and the possible thought of batting again. But the moment belongs to the debutant - Praveen Jayawickrama. 6/92 in 32 overs! He has single-handedly run through the Bangladeshis. Well, nearly single-handedly...

The umpire refers it upstairs and replay shows that Taijul loses his shoe while going back, which in turn, hits the stumps! SRI LANKA GET A LEAD OF 242.

The third and the last session could be an interesting one. The Bangladesh batters are under pressure, they are 80 runs away from avoiding the follow-on. But they will hope for a partnership now. Sri Lanka on the other hand will try to keep the pressure on and take timely wickets. The third session could well decide which way this game is going. Stay tuned.

We are back for the final session on Day 3! Sri Lanka will go for the kill and will look to skittle out Bangladesh in short time. Bangladesh on the other hand, need a solid partnership. Liton Das is the new man.

A wicket right at the end means it is yet another good session for Lanka! Once again they have managed to take two in it and two big ones, Rahim and Tamim. Both were taken by Jayawickrama who has three so far in the game. After losing Tamim early on in this session, Mominul and Rahim were going along nicely. Yes, there were nervous moments out in the middle but they were battling it out in not so easy conditions to bat. Just as it seemed like they would head into the break 3 down, a really good review from the Lankans has seen them get rid of Rahim.

Rahim misses his defence and is hit on the pads. There is a big appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Sri Lanka decide to review at the last moment. There is nothing on the Ultra Edge and Ball Tracker shows that it is hitting the stumps. It was pretty straight and the only thing that could have saved Rahim was an inside edge. THAT IS TEA ON DAY 3!

Loopy ball, outside off. Mominul Haque pushes it to point.
Shorter and wider outside off. Whipped to mid on.
Tossed up, outside off. Mominul Haque gets forward to defend it.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to mid on.
The physio is out there to look at Tamim Iqbal's shoulder.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended out.
Just a single as this is clipped to deep mid-wicket.

A bit of misunderstanding but all is well in the end! Fuller ball, on off. Eased to mid on. Tamim runs across for a run but Mominul Haque sends him back. Luckily for Bangladesh, the fielder fumbles and Tamim makes it back in time.
Lands on a length outside off and turns back in sharply. Tamim Iqbal gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls away. A leg bye is taken.
Fuller this time, around off. This is clipped wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Loopy ball, on off. Tamim Iqbal is solid in his defence.
Flighted ball, it lands outside off. Mominul Haque gets to the ball and pushes it to extra cover.
Fuller ball, around off. Pushed away to cover.
On off. Defended out by Mominul Haque.
Flatter ball, outside off. Tapped to short third man. Tamim Iqbal wants the run and is halfway down the track but Mominul Haque sends him back.
Loopy ball, on off. Kept out.
FOUR! Poor and punished! Shorter ball, outside off. Mominul Haque rocks back and pulls it past mid on.
Tossed up again. A solid front foot defence by Tamim Iqbal is the answer.
Tossed up, on the pads. Tamim looks to work it down the leg side but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes to short leg.
Flighted ball, on off. Mominul Haque pushes it wide of mid off and takes one.
Drifting on the pads this time. Tamim works it to deep mid-wicket and takes one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Tossed up, outside off. Tamim Iqbal gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Darts one on the stumps. Mominul Haque defends it from the crease.
Flatter ball, on the stumps. Defended from the crease.
Shorter ball, around off. Pushed away to point.
Play and a miss! Tossed up, outside off. Mominul Haque goes for the booming drive but misses it.
Shorter ball, on middle and leg. Tamim clips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended out.
Fuller ball, on off. Eased down to square leg.
Flighted ball, on off. Mominul Haque lunges forward and dead bats this one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mominul Haque is solid in his defence.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended.
FOUR! Just away over the fielder! Short ball, outside off. Mominul Haque rocks back and pulls it over the leaping square leg fielder.
Shorter ball, around off. Tamim clips it past mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and wider again. Tamim rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for one.
Shorter and wider outside off. Cut away to point.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended.
Shorter and wide outside off. Cut away to deep cover. It should have been a single but the fielder makes a poor throw to the keeper and they collect an extra run.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.
Beaten! Lands on middle and turns away past Mominul Haque's attempted defence.
Tamim comes down the track and clips it to mid-wicket. Good over by Praveen Jayawickrama.
On off. Defended off the front foot.
Tossed up, lands on middle and turns down the leg side.
FOUR! Dropped! Deft touch! Drifting down the leg side. Tamim Iqbal tickles it down to fine leg fence. The man at leg slip didn't even attempt to go for the catch.
Tossed up, around off. Tamim is solid in his defence.
Loopy ball, on off. Defended out.

We are back for the second session on Day 3! It is a very important session. If Sri Lanka does well here and picks up wickets, then they will be in firm control of the game. Bangladesh needs to put on a strong partnership to avoid just that. Mominul Haque is the new man in and Praveen Jayawickrama to start off with the ball.

Earlier in the session, Sri Lanka walked in to bat. They added 24 before Ramesh fell to Taskin and they declared after that. Now, by getting two wickets, they will look to force the Bangladeshi batting on the back foot. The wicket is still looking really good for batting. However, a few balls have misbehaved and that will keep the Lankan spinners interested. Join us for the afternoon session to find out how things pan out.

The Sri Lankan bowlers gave it their all but they didn't get the success. The pacers bowled tightly. They did beat the bat a couple of times. There were a few shouts for LBW but nothing has gone their way. The spinners came in and the odd balls were spinning sharply but the openers looked determined until the second last over before Lunch. Jayawickrama, the debutant, provided them the breakthrough and Ramesh got them the second wicket in the next over to make sure Sri Lanka are not going to the break empty-handed.

An excellent session with the bat for Bangladesh. The Bangladeshi openers got them a perfect start with Tamim getting to his half ton and once again taking on the bowlers. Saif looked a bit tentative but after a while, he started to play his shots. However, he fell at the stroke of Lunch. Shanto followed him to the pavilion without troubling the scorers.

Superb finish the session for Sri Lanka. Two wickets in the last two overs before Lunch and they will be the happier side going into the break. Tamim and Saif were looking really solid but Saif got out just before Lunch and Shanto has bagged a duck again, as he got dismissed on the last ball before the Lunch. Tamim is still out there though, batting positively and that's the only sign of relief for Bangladesh.

OUT! TAKEN! Ramesh gets a wicket on the last ball before wicket. Another duck for Shanto. Terrific bowling from Mendis. He bowls this fullish and around middle, Shanto is drawn forward as he looks to defend. A bit spin away and the ball takes the outside edge. Thirimanne at the second slip makes no mistake. With this wicket, it is Lunch on Day 3.
Flat and around off, Najmul keeps it out.
Flat and just around off, Iqbal goes back and punches it to deep cover for one. 2 balls for Shanto to survive.
Big turn again! Floated around off, Tamim comes forward and looks to defend but the ball breaks away sharply to beat the bat.
On middle, kept out.
Flat and around off, turning away. Poked on the off side.
Floated around middle, Shanto looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes to square leg.
On off, kept out.
Najmul Hossain Shanto is in at 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Maiden Test wicket for Jayawickrama. Lovely stuff from him. The entire Sri Lankan dressing room claps. Floated around off and middle, Saif looks to defend by coming forward but he fails to get to the pitch. Ends up getting an outside edge and the ball goes to the slip region. De Silva at the second slip grabs the chance low to left. Sri Lanka gets the wicket at the stroke of Lunch.
On middle, pushed on the leg side for a quick run.
On middle, blocked.
Floated around middle, worked on the leg side.
Full and around off, it is eased to long off for one.
Floated outside off, this one is left alone.
Big turn! Flat and around off, Tamim looks to defend but misses as it spins away and bounces extra. The ball hits Dickwella on the shoulder.
Outside off, fuller in length. Pushed ot mid off.

NOT OUT! The back leg never went up. Floated full and down the leg side. Tamim misses his flick. The keeper collects the ball and takes the bails off. Appeals for the stumping. The TV umpire has been called for. On replay is enough to declare it not out.
Stumping appeal taken upstairs. Looks safe though. Let's see the replay.
On off, Tamim blocks.
Flat and outside off, paded away.
Around off this time, it is kept out.
Beaten! Tossed up and outside off, Saif looks to drive but misses as the balls spins away. The keeper fumbles. Don't think there was an edge though.
Flat and around off, this time Tamim goes back and punches it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flat and around middle, it spins in. Tamim misses his flick.
On middle, kept out.

Appeal for a catch down the leg side but only from the keeper. It lands on middle and spins in. Saif looks to clip it on the leg side but misses. Dickwella moves to his left and collects. Big appeal from him but the umpire is not interested. Sri Lankan skipper is not keen either.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over. Saif is looking superb now! Ramesh once again gives the ball air and bowls it wide too. Hassan hits it through the covers for another boundary. Too easy now.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! DRILLED! Full and wide outside off, Saif slams it through the covers to bag another boundary.
Good stop! Flat and just outside off, Saif waits for it and then taps it to the right of the slip fielder who dives to his right and stops.
Full and outside off, driven wide of point for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Wide outside off, it is fuller in length. Saif uses the long handle and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
Very full and around off, pushed to mid off.
Full and around off, Saif gets forward and defends it.
On middle, clipped through square leg for one.
On off, blocked.
Dropped short this time. Poor ball to follow up. Tamim is happy to punch it to deep cover for one.
Play and a miss! Mendis gets closer and loops it again. Tamim is lured into driving this one. Makes no connection.
Outside off again, left alone.
On off, Tamim gets ahead and blocks it solidly.
Tossed up and just outside off, spins further away. Tamim lets it be.
Full and around middle, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Floated around off, Saif comes on the front foot and defends.
Tossed up and around off, pushed to mid off.
Fuller and around middle again. this is defended.
Flat and around middle, blocked.
Flat and around off, it is pushed to long on for one.
Floated on middle, Tamim gets forward and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Down the leg side. Left alone.
Floated on middle, it is blocked again.
On middle, watchfully blocked.
Full and down the leg side, Saif looks to work it on the leg side but misses. The keeper fumbles too.
Flatter and around middle, worked on the leg side this time.
On off, pushed to cover.
On off, paddled to the man at short leg.
Full and around middle, played back to the bowler.
On off, kept out.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. That wasn't too far from the fielder. Tamim is taking a few risks here. Floated on off, Tamim goes for the sweep. It goes to the right of short fine leg. Ramesh there dives full length to his right but he cannot get hands to it. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! BANG! Up and over! Tamim is not going to stop playing his shots. Tossed up and around off, Tamim dances down and slams it over extra cover for a boundary.

Big appeal but turned down. No review from Sri Lanka. Floated just outside off, Iqbal looks to drive but the ball lands on the rough and spins in. Tamim gets hit on the back pad. A loud, loud appeal but turned down. Replay later rolled in and it showed it would've missed the leg pole.
Full and on middle, Saif defends it again.
On middle, kept out again. Saif looking a bit scratchy at the moment.
On off, blocked off the front foot now.
Down the leg side, Saif misses his flick this time.

In the air... safe! Was there some bat though? Floated on middle, Saif looks to defend but the ball hits his pad and lobs wide of leg slip. Tamim wants the single but Saif is not keen. Tamim quickly returns.
Full and on the pads, kept out.
Full and around middle, flicked to square leg for nothing.
This time he gets on the front foot and bunts it on the off side.
Outside off, Tamim looks ot play the slog sweep. Misses to get hit on the pad.
Full and around off, blocked.
Flat and around middle, worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely done! Floated on middle, Tamim paddles it down to the fine leg fence. The fielder gives it a chase and puts in a valiant effort but fails to keep the ball in.
SIX! BANG! Where's that come from? Saif decides to join Tamim. Floated on middle, he bangs it over long on for a biggie. He danced down the track and slammed it hard. 15 off the over.

FIFTY FOR TAMIM! Once again a very good inning. His third in as many innings this series. He is having a time of his life at the moment. Short and wide, punched wide of backward point for one. 61 is the score of the team and 50 of them have come off the willow of Tamim. He did something similar in the first innings of the first game as well. And he is doing it here too. His 4th successive half ton in Tests. Can he get to his first ton of this series now?
Flat and around middle, Tamim goes back and flicks it to mid-wicket.
On off, kept out.

FOUR! Another boundary. This one is not off the middle but Tamim will take it. Tossed up and around off, Iqbal looks to go over cover. He though ends up slicing it over point. The ball races to the fence. Tamim goes to 49 now.
FOUR! Cut way! Width outside off and Tamim pounces on it. It lands short and just outside off and turns away. Tamim stays on the back foot and thunps it through the covers for a boundary.
Full and around off, pushed to the cover fielder. Maiden to begin from Jayawickrama.
Darted outside off, left alone.
Flat and around off, poked to point.
Around off, blocked off the front foot.
Turn and bounce! This one probably landed on a rough. It lands just outside off and turns away with bounce.
Debutant Praveen Jayawickrama to bowl now.
Flat and around off, worked on the leg side.
FOUR! Drilled! Full and around off, Tamim dances down and smacks it through mid on. The ball races away to the fence. Tamim is into the 40s. 50-stand is up.
Floated around off, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, blocked by Tamim.
Outside off, spinning away. Tamim lets it go.
Flat and around off, kept out.
Shortish and just outside off, tucked to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! A very good start from Bangladesh so far. Tamim has looked solid as ever while Saif, his partner, is hanging in there. Sri Lanka would look to get at least one wicket before the Lunch break. Let's see who can get them that breakthrough.
Around off on a length, Saif keeps it out off the front foot.
Short and outside off, this time Saif punches it wide of the cover fielder. Takes two.
In the channel outside off again, Saif lets it go behind.
Fullish but wide outside off, left alone.
On the pads this time, it is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Good length and around off, kept out.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg for a two.

In the air... safe! Tamim doesn't want the spinner to settle in. Ramesh loops it up again and it is around off, Tamim is down the track again. This time he ends up slicing it off the outer half. Manages to clear the point fielder. Two taken.
FOUR! Driven nicely! Tossed up and around off, Tamim dances down the track again and drills it through the covers for a boundary.
Full and around off, kept out.
Flat and around off, Tamim comes down the track and punches it to the cover region.
Floated around off, blocked off the front foot.
Bowling change! Ramesh Mendis is on now.
Good length and around middle, worked on the leg side.
Fullish and around middle, worked on the leg side for one.
FOUR! SHOT! Wide outside off, this one is slightly short. Tamim punches the drive through the covers for a boundary.
Angled away from outside off, left alone.
On off, kept out.
Good length and just outside off, pushed to point.
Change! Angelo Mathews to bowl now.
Fuller and around off, driven to mid off.
Outside off again, this time Saif looks to play the drive. The ball moves away to beat the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
On the pads again, this one is flicked to fine leg for one.
Full and down the leg side, Tamim misses his flick. The keeper does well to dive to his right and collect.
Issue with the ball. The umpire tries to pass it through the 8-ball gauge but it doesn't. New balls please. A box comes out.
Good length and around off, Tamim blocks off the front foot.
Shortish and just around off, Saif gets on his toes and blocks.
Just outside off on a length, Saif is solid in defense.
Angled away from around off, left alone.
FOUR! Nicely done! Down the leg side and Saif doesn't miss out. He just tickles it down to the fence at fine leg. This will feel him better.
Fuller and just outside off, Saif defends it.
Good length delivery around middle, worked on the leg side.
Around off on a length, kept out.
Fullish and around off, punched to mid on for nothing.
Full and wide outside off, it is driven wide of the diving point fielder who gets a hand to it. The ball slows down and stops near the fence. Two taken.
Around off on a length, blocked on the leg side.
Edgy! Fuller and around off, Tamim looks to play it on the off side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to the off side.
Good length and around off, kept out.

Another huge appeal. Again turned down. No review again. A length ball, outside off, it is angled in and it sharply comes back in Tamim misses his flick again gets hit high on the pad. Big, big appeal from the bowler but not out says the umpire. They take a leg bye.
Good length and around off, pushed to the left of the bowler.
Saif is off the mark. Short ball around middle, Saif tucks it to deep square leg for one.
Full and outside off, Saif drives it well but straight to short cover.
Full and down the leg side, on the pads. Tamim looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pad and goes to fine leg. Leg bye taken.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid off.
Good length and around off and middle, Saif is solid in defense.
Very full and around off, kept out.
Around off on a length, it is poked to point for a quick single.

Big appeal again! There was some noise but Sri Lanka didn't go for the review this time. Good length and outside off, Tamim looks to defend it on the off side but misses. The ball goes behind. Dickwella catches and appeals. Turned down. Big gap between the bat and pad, shows the replay. The noise was bat hitting the pad.

Big appeal but not out! Very full and on the pads, Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball goes to fine leg and they take two. A big appeal but it is turned down. Leg byes given.
Good length and just outside off, punched to point.
Fullish and leaving the right-hander from just outside off, it is left alone.
Around off on a length, it is pushed to mid on for one.
Short and around middle, pushed to mid on.
FOUR! This is easy and this is good. Short and wide outside off, Tamim waits for it and then punches it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! SHOT! Classy from Tamim. Good length and around off, Tamim just punches the drive and finds the gap as well. The ball races away to the fence.
Good length and around middle, punched to mid on.
Wonderfully driven! Lakmal overpitches it around off, Tamim hits it down the ground. Mid off chases it down. Three taken.
Short and wide, Tamim looks to drive but mistimes it to mid off.
Good length and around middle, solidly defended.
On middle, kept out by Tamim.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Full and just around off, kept out.
Full and just outside off, Saif looks to play the drive but ends up getting an inside edge on the pad again. Good over from Vishwa.
Short and wide, Hasssan looks to punch it on the off side but ends up getting it off the bottom edge.
Length ball around off, it comes back in just a touch. Saif looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge on the pad.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Good stop! A length ball on the pads, Tamim flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket. The ball slows down as it goes to the fence. The fielder gives it a chase and does really well to flick it back in. Jayawickrama was the fielder. Three taken.
A length ball on the pads, Tamim flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Who will partner Lakmal from the other end? It is Vishwa Fernando.
Around off on a length, Hassan blocks off the front foot.
On the pads, it is clipped to fine leg for one.
Full and around off, solidly blocked.
FOUR! SHOT! Tamim is up and running with a lovely shot. A fuller ball around middle, Tamim flicks it through mid-wicket and finds the fence.

Review time! Has Sri Lanka got one? The umpire thinks otherwise but Karunaratne has gone for the review. Where is it pitching? Let's see the Ultra Edge first. Nothing on Ultra Edge. Let's see the Ball Tracker. Pitching outside leg. Sri Lanka lose their one review in the first over it self.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg. Sri Lanka have lost the review. A length ball around the pads, Tamim looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pad. A loud appeal but it is turned down. They go for the review. Only to lose it as the Ball Tracker shows it to be pitching outside leg.
Lakmal is on the money! Fuller and around off, makes the batsman play the first ball. Tamim is solid in defense too.
